stories.h: Germany publishes its first explicit fossil-fuel exit roadmap
stories.w: The federal government committed to transition away from fossil energy by 2045, lift renewables from roughly 55% to at least 80% of electricity by 2030 and finish coal generation no later than 2038, turning a broad climate-neutrality goal into a sector-by-sector policy framework.

stories.h: US and Iran reopen mediated talks over war and Hormuz
stories.w: Qatar-mediated talks at the UN lasted three hours and were described by Washington as productive, while Tehran said its seven preconditions remained in place; the possibility of reopening the Strait of Hormuz within days pushed Brent crude below $100 before uncertainty returned.

stories.h: Sri Lankan court sentences 15 men over the Easter bombings
stories.w: A three-judge High Court panel imposed prison terms of 200 to 260 years on 15 defendants convicted of helping organize the 2019 attacks that killed 267 people; nine others were acquitted, while unresolved claims of a wider conspiracy remain under investigation.

stories.h: China expands controls on exports of drug precursor chemicals
stories.w: Beijing added two chemicals to a licensing regime covering shipments to the United States, Mexico and Canada, bringing the controlled list to 18 and creating a concrete counternarcotics deliverable ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting.
